results.label: Disable entry improvement
results.mechanism_note: Remove the 1-tick favorable LIMIT improvement requirement to test whether more fills outweigh poorer entry quality.

results.label: Require 2-tick improvement
results.mechanism_note: Demand a stricter favorable LIMIT improvement to test whether better entry quality offsets the expected fill loss.

results.label: Disable LIMIT fallback
results.mechanism_note: Turn off fallback-to-market to see whether O1 net is mostly coming from rescued LIMIT orders rather than pure passive fills.

results.label: Faster LIMIT fallback
results.mechanism_note: Shorten fallback timeout to 5 minutes to test whether earlier rescue improves fill completion without too much adverse execution.

results.label: Slower LIMIT fallback
results.mechanism_note: Delay fallback timeout to 15 minutes to test whether more patience improves entry quality enough to offset lost fills.

results.label: Zero fallback slip
results.mechanism_note: Remove extra adverse ticks on fallback fills to test whether O1 is over-penalizing market rescue quality.

results.label: 2-tick fallback slip
results.mechanism_note: Increase fallback slip penalty to 2 ticks to test whether O1 is understating the cost of market rescue fills.
